rule.statement: A deed must be construed according to the ordinary connotation of the language used in it and the intention ascertained from the words employed by the parties.
rule.supporting_quote: Hence the Appellants cannot claim a prescriptive title to lot 1 and 2 of the said preliminary plan No 3399 based on the possession of their predecessors in title. Accordingly I answer the aforesaid questions of law set out in sub paragraph ‘f’ and ‘g’ of paragraph 10 of the amended petition of appeal in the negative.
